MISSING_SERVER_ID: Your application is missing your server ID. Please include both your in-game character name and server ID, for example: S14 Bubble.
MISSING_PLAYER_NAME: Your application is missing your in-game character name. Please include both your character name and server ID, for example: S14 Bubble.
INCOMPLETE_APPLICATION: We couldn't identify complete character information in your application. Please provide your in-game character name and server ID, for example: S14 Bubble.
INVALID_SERVER_ID: The server ID in your application could not be recognized. Please check your server ID and submit your application again. Example: S14 Bubble.
MULTIPLE_SERVER_IDS: Multiple server IDs were found in your application. Please submit only your current server ID together with your in-game character name, for example: S14 Bubble.
AMBIGUOUS_APPLICATION: We couldn't clearly identify your character and server information. Please resubmit your application using a clear format such as: S14 Bubble.
